notes.title: Announcement: Release Date for "Grief like a Stray Dog"
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our game "Grief like a Stray Dog" will be released on [b]January 29, 2025.[/b]  

We are also thrilled to present our new trailer!

[previewyoutube=9aNofnAN2Sw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]An Interactive Narrative of Loss and Resilience[/h2]

"[b]Grief like a Stray Dog[/b]" is an interactive play that combines elements of a visual novel and an adventure game. The story unfolds in a small village behind the front lines during World War II. The player will immerse themselves in the story of young Nadia, who, stepping in for her sick mother, becomes a postwoman delivering news from the front. Among the letters are not only words of hope but also tragic notifications.

[h3]Availability [/h3]
The game supports controller input (Xbox) and will be available in both Russian and English. The game’s translation into other languages is in development.

[h3]About Our Team[/h3]
Rayonist is an independent studio that creates games with memorable artistic solutions, deep storylines, and a unique atmosphere.
